lessons_used: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted performance, while zero or negative forecasts repeatedly preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-16.0% and -9.1%).
Redesigning the story stage (choose_path, redesign) yielded 2 clear winning tests (+7.6% and +5.7%), though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Choose path copy changes (choose_path, copy) hurt performance in 2 tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced inconsistent outcomes, driving both significant wins (+2.5% to +6.7%) and severe losses (-4.5% to -9.5%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both tests, and categories with fewer than 2 agreeing tests remain thin evidence.

candidates.title: Story Screen Split View Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the story screen to use a split layout with narrative text on one side and companion visual previews on the other.
candidates.why: Earlier onboarding tests showed story screen redesigns yielded consistent wins (+7.6% and +5.7%), helping engage users before path selection.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout inside onboarding is allowed and preserves its purpose.

candidates.score_note: Choose path redesigns consistently deliver positive lift (+4.0% average).

candidates.title: Sign In Spotlight Focus Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a spotlight layout that emphasizes account protection and pet backup benefits.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again; sign_in has an 11.9% drop-off.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign-in screen layout inside onboarding is allowed and preserves its purpose.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail alignment, but sign-in redesigns yield modest historical gains.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Two Column Showcase Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the companion selection screen into a two-column layout comparing pet attributes and visuals side by side.
candidates.why: Adoption has the second lowest step conversion at 78.8% with a long median duration of 89s, indicating decision friction.

guard.reason: Redesigning the companion pick screen into a two-column layout is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but adoption redesigns show mixed historical results.

candidates.title: Companion Personality Trait Builder Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated personality trait customization screen between companion pick and photo upload steps.
candidates.why: Users take median 89s on adoption; adding a structured trait choice step enhances emotional connection and guides users to completion.

guard.reason: Adding a new trait builder screen inside onboarding while preserving all required steps is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding extra screens to onboarding consistently hurts completion rates.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Notification Opt-In
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts and generation progress details on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes a median 201s and mean 2336s, causing significant drop-off while pet generation occurs in background.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen information and notification options is explicitly allowed in onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info updates reliably yield positive results (+2.0% over 6 tests).

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Docking Hint

candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on controlling, hiding, or interacting with the pet after onboarding, while finish stage conversion drops to 68.0%.

home_intro.hint: Control your pet anytime via the system tray taskbar icon or shortcut menu.

guard.reason: Adding usage instructions to the home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with support tickets, but finish hints previously lost conversion.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Sync Protection Hint
candidates.change: Display a confirmation hint on the adoption certificate screen reassuring users that pet progress is saved.
candidates.why: Addressing account sync concerns (8 support emails) before finishing adoption builds trust and prevents drop-off before generation.

adoption_certificate.hint: Your new pet details and preferences are safely saved to your signed-in account.

guard.reason: Adding a data save confirmation hint on the adoption certificate screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Support emails align, but adoption hints showed negative historical lift (-4.8%).

candidates.title: Sign In Device Sync Assurance Hint
candidates.change: Add a hint to the sign-in screen confirming that account login preserves and syncs pet data.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were reported regarding reset or missing pets upon re-authenticating.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your desktop companion is backed up and recoverable anytime.

guard.reason: Adding an account backup assurance hint on the sign-in screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence, though sign-in hints produce modest positive impact (+0.7%).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Spotlight Dock Layout
candidates.change: Update the waiting screen layout to a spotlight format centering pet generation status.
candidates.why: Waiting stage suffers high mean duration (2336s); a spotlight presentation clarifies active pet processing status.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen layout inside onboarding is allowed and preserves its purpose.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high wait time friction using layout adjustment.

candidates.change: Update the home intro screen layout to a split view displaying launch action alongside desktop control highlights.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 68.0% (mean 5815s); a split layout presents launch steps clearly without adding additional screen overhead.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen layout is allowed inside onboarding.
